trackSource.notes: The official site has an interactive circuits map (https://app-circuits.lamitja.cat/) with no readable text or file link; no GPX, KML or My Maps link was found on 2026-11-27.

notes: Found by scout-races discovery on 2026-11-27 via the HDsports Spain calendar. Size evidence: the half marathon regulations close entries at 8,000. Article 3 of the regulations lists the half marathon corral starts from 10:30 to 10:35, but the article does not name the edition, so start time and waves were not recorded. The 10K and El Quart are separate distances and are not followed.
